resolvedBugs.title: Postgres Unique Constraint 23505 Collision on Assignment Roster Sync
resolvedBugs.issue: Updating assignment shift_code blindly when operator held 2 active shifts collided with unique index idx_oma_machine_active_shift_code.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Preserve existing assigned shifts; only update if shift_code IS NULL and no active assignment already holds that shift code.

resolvedBugs.title: Excessive Running Hours (> 24h) Accepted
resolvedBugs.issue: Server accepted erroneous logs exceeding 24 running hours on a single shift.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Added table check constraint chk_machine_hour_logs_max_running_hours and RPC guard throwing 23514.

resolvedBugs.title: Breakdown Duration Exceeding Shift Length Accepted
resolvedBugs.issue: RPC accepted breakdown durations exceeding the total shift length (e.g. 10h breakdown on 8h shift).
resolvedBugs.resolution: Added RPC duration bound check: raises exception 23514 if breakdown_hours > shift_duration_hours.

resolvedBugs.title: Logging on Inactive or Under-Maintenance Machine Accepted
resolvedBugs.issue: Equipment decommissioned or under overhaul accepted operational shift hour logs.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Added operational status guard: raises exception 23514 if status = 'inactive' OR health_status = 'under_maintenance'.

resolvedBugs.title: Client-Machine Deployment Mismatch Accepted
resolvedBugs.issue: Passing mismatched client_id for deployed machine was inserted without validating machines.client_id.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Added deployment validation: raises exception 23503 if machines.client_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id <> p_client_id.

resolvedBugs.title: Operator 7-Day Window Bypass via Service Role
resolvedBugs.issue: Trigger relied strictly on auth.uid(), which is null when called from service-role Server Actions.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Updated trigger to inspect NEW.entry_source = 'operator' and entered_by user role, plus added explicit RPC guard.

resolvedBugs.title: Client Shift Code Lost in Dashboard Entry
resolvedBugs.issue: submitOperatorHourLogAction omitted shiftCode, causing backend trigger to default to 'S1' instead of assigned client shift code ('A').
resolvedBugs.resolution: Passed shiftCode: assignedShiftCode and dynamic client shift code resolution.

resolvedBugs.title: Overtime Bleed on Shift Card Selection
resolvedBugs.issue: Picking a shift card did not reset previous manual overtime input, carrying manual overtime into template shifts.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Explicitly reset overtime to template defaults (0 or default_ot_minutes / 60) upon selecting a shift card.

resolvedBugs.title: Obsolete Overload Signature Collision
resolvedBugs.issue: Migration created a new overload with differing parameter order without dropping the older signature, causing PostgreSQL error 42725 (not unique).
resolvedBugs.resolution: Added DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS for the obsolete signature, leaving a single canonical function.

resolvedBugs.title: Audit Log Column Discrepancy
resolvedBugs.issue: RPC inserted into audit_logs using non-existent column 'performed_by', throwing PostgreSQL error 42703 on valid shift logs.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Updated audit log insertion to use 'user_id' and 'entity_type: machine_hour_logs'.

resolvedBugs.title: Operator Assigned Shift Enforcement Across Database and Frontends
resolvedBugs.issue: Operator assigned to Shift A on Machine 1 could log for Shift B without server rejection.
resolvedBugs.resolution: Enforced in RPC submit_operator_hour_log_atomic (raises exception 23514), in Web submitOperatorHourLogAction pre-check, ShiftInputs badge/banner, and Mobile MeterLogModal pre-check and real-time subscription.
